message.content:
This is a leave-on skin-care body spray with exfoliating and hydrating action, so it belongs in heading 3304 (beauty or skin-care preparations) rather than a soap or medicament heading.

Within 3304, subheading 3304.99 covers "Other" preparations, and 3304.99.50 covers the other skin-care preparations that are not specifically named. The statistical suffix 3304.99.5000 reads "Other," which fits a body spray sold in retail packaging.

The stated Canadian origin of the raw materials and the filling may qualify the product for USMCA treatment, but that does not change the classification.
